items: UPS Ground fuel table adds 0.5 point. The table effective Nov. 2 charges 0.50 percentage point more than the old one at the same diesel price, so the Oct. 26 diesel price of $6.35 gives 30.25% against 29.50% this week. On $100,000 a month of Ground transportation charges, that is about $500 a month.

DoorDash agrees to buy Instacart. DoorDash will pay $65.00 a share, an equity value of about $17 billion, with at least 75% in cash. The companies expect to close at the end of 2027 or in the first half of 2028, after a stockholder vote and antitrust reviews in the US, Canada and Israel.

Amazon withdraws Westborough drone site application. Amazon asked, in an Oct. 30 letter, to withdraw its site plan review application without prejudice, according to local lawmakers. The plan covered packages under 5 pounds within a 7.5-mile radius of its Westborough, Mass., fulfillment center.
